```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)

TABLE_NUMBER <- 0
```

```{r}
#| label: sample_size
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat(paste0("\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ".a) SAMPLE SIZE}}\\vspace{5mm}"))

cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}")
cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
  df_sample <- readRDS("export/rds/df_samples.rds")
  sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_sample)))
  df_formatted <- df_sample |>
    mutate(
      Power = sprintf("%.2f", Power)
    )
  colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Power", "Delta = 0.3", "Delta = 0.4", "Delta = 0.5")
  df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
  df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.table(
    df_aligned,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "     "
  )
cat("\\end{verbatim}")
cat("\\end{adjustwidth}")
```

```{r}
#| label: power_analysis
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat(paste0("\\vspace{5mm}\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ".b) POWER ANALYSIS}}\\vspace{5mm}"))

cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}\n")
cat("\\begin{verbatim}\n")
  df <- readRDS("export/rds/df_complete.rds")
  cat(paste("With N =", nrow(df), "\n\n"))
  df_powers <- readRDS("export/rds/df_powers.rds")
  sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_powers)))
  df_formatted <- df_powers|>
    mutate(
      across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.2f", .))
    )
  colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Delta = 0.3", "Delta = 0.4", "Delta = 0.5")
  df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
  df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.table(
    df_aligned,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "     "
  )
  TABLE_NUMBER <- TABLE_NUMBER + 1
cat("\\end{verbatim}")
cat("\\end{adjustwidth}")
```

```{r}
#| label: comparisons
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| out.width: "80%"

cat(paste0("\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ") MULTIPLE COMPARISONS}}\\vspace{5mm}"))

rds_files <- list.files(
  path = "export/rds", 
  pattern = "^df_shapiro_.*\\.rds$",
  full.names = FALSE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
clean_names <- sub("^df_shapiro_", "", rds_files)
clean_names <- sub("\\.rds$", "", clean_names)

for (name in clean_names) {
  
  cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}")
  cat("\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}")
  cat("\\begin{verbatim}")
  
  header <- paste0("Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, "." , which(clean_names == name), ") [", toupper(name), "] ANALYSIS")
  cat(header, "\n\n")
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NORMALITY CHECK
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("· NORMALITY CHECK\n\n")
  df_shapiro <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_shapiro_", name, ".rds")) |> select(-2)
  sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_shapiro)))
  df_formatted <- df_shapiro |>
    mutate(
      across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))
    )
  df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Time", "Statistic", "P-value", "Normality")
  df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
  df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.table(
    df_aligned,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "     "
  )
  cat("\n")
  if(all(df_shapiro$p > 0.05)) {
    cat("Normality RESPECTED --> ANOVA\n\n")
    
    # ANOVA
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    cat("· ANOVA [CORRECTED]\n\n")
    df_anova <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_anova_", name, ".rds"))
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_anova)))
    df_formatted <- df_anova |>
      mutate(
        across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))
      )
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Statistic", "DoF", "P-value")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "     "
    )
    cat("\n")
    df_anova_corrected <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_anova_corrected_", name, ".rds"))
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_anova_corrected)))
    df_formatted <- df_anova_corrected |>
      mutate(
        across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))
      )
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Statistic", "DoF", "P-value", "Correction")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "     "
    )
    cat("\n")
    
    # HOLM/BONFERRONI PAIRWISE COMPARISON ----------------------------
    cat("· HOLM/BONFERROBI PAIRWISE COMPARISON\n\n")
    df_pairwise <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_pairwise_", name, ".rds")) |> select(c(2, 3, 6, 9))
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_pairwise)))
    df_formatted <- df_pairwise |>
      mutate(
        statistic = sprintf("%.2f", statistic),
        p.adj = sprintf("%.3f", p.adj)
      )
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("GR1", "GR2", "Statistic", "P-value")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "     "
    )
    cat("\n")

  } else {
    cat("Normality VIOLATED --> FRIEDMAN TEST\n\n")
    
    # FRIEDMAN TEST
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    cat("· FRIEDMAN TEST\n\n")
    df_friedman <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_friedman_", name, ".rds"))
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_friedman)))
    df_formatted <- df_friedman |>
      mutate(
        across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .))
      )
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Chi squared", "DoF", "P-value")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "     "
    )
    cat("\n")
    
    # DURBIN/CONOVER PAIRWISE COMPARISON -----------------------------
    cat("· DURBIN/CONOVER PAIRWISE COMPARISON\n\n")
    df_conover <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_conover_", name, ".rds"))
    sep = c(rep(" ", length(df_conover)))
    df_formatted <- df_conover
    df_formatted <- data.frame(lapply(df_formatted, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(df_formatted) <- c("Time 1", "Time 2", "Statistic", "P-value")
    df_with_header <- rbind(as.list(colnames(df_formatted)), sep, df_formatted)
    df_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_with_header, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df_aligned <- as.data.frame(mapply(format, df_char, justify = c(rep("centre", ncol(df_char))), SIMPLIFY = FALSE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    write.table(
      df_aligned,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = FALSE,
      quote = FALSE,
      sep = "     "
    )
  }
  cat("\\end{verbatim}\n")
  
  cat("\\vspace{5mm}")
  cat("\\begin{center}")
  cat("\\includegraphics[width=0.75\\textwidth]{export/img/placeholder.pdf}")
  cat("\\end{center}")
  
  cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
  cat("\\end{adjustwidth}\n")
}
```
